local keep = 41
if checkpointmanager.Condition("OUTER") then
    say(luamanager.GetStoryText("D_DEMO"))
    keep = keep + 1
else
    say("alternate")
end
mark_progress(keep)
local options = {}
options[1] = "O_DEMO_A"
options[2] = "O_DEMO_B"
local selected = choose(options)
if selected == 1 then mark_progress(100) else mark_progress(200) end
say("ending")
